question: Why did you make him a boy?
answer: It does seem like this is what everyone wants to know, but it’s just because I had things I wanted to do that I couldn’t without someone who “Looks like a girl but is a boy”. Also, making him cute was largely Otsuka-sensei’s achievement. I just wrote “A cute girlish cat-eared boy”. Otsuka-sensei is the guilty one.
